column4: When the monster's health ratio drops to 60% and 30% for the first time，the damage is increased by 35%
When a monster deals damage，it adds a random debuff to the target.
The monster's speed is reduced by 15%, but its action bar is increased by 15% each time it takes damage.
When a monster deals damage，it gains a random bonus.
At the start of the battle, the monster's damage is increased by 45%, and this effect is reduced by 15% each round.
For every 10% reduction in the monster's health, 4% damage is gained.
